title: Spatial Card Gallery
summary: Click a card or pinch out to enter the spatial view. Drag to explore, then pinch in or tap empty space—not a background card—to return to the five-row grid.

blocks.content:
Sports-card collections become difficult to navigate when every item competes for the same amount of space. This experiment explores a continuous transition between a compact five-row gallery and a free-moving spatial field.

The same cards remain visible throughout the transition, preserving orientation while allowing one card to become the focus.
The interaction should feel like moving through one collection—not switching between two unrelated screens.

- Drag to pan through the collection.
- Click a card or pinch out to enter the spatial view.
- Pinch in or tap empty space—not a background card—to return to the compact grid.
- Tap any card to bring it into focus.
- Use arrow keys, plus, minus, and zero for keyboard navigation.
